author: heliox
description: Create sessions table for persistent session history
up: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_path TEXT NOT NULL, number INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'waiting', description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'copilot', role_id TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER, ended_at INTEGER, premium_requests INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_api_duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_project ON sessions(project_path)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_created ON sessions(created_at)
